description: Every golden record must have an employee_id
employee_ids must be unique after deduplication
employee_ids must follow the GT-XXXXXX or AC-XXXXXX format
Every employee must have a first name
Every employee must have a last name
At least 90% of employees should have an email address
Email addresses must be in a valid format
Email addresses must be unique after deduplication
Every employee must have a hire date
Hire dates must fall between 1970-01-01 and today
Every employee must be assigned to a department
All department values must match the approved taxonomy
Dedup step must annotate each record with its contributing source systems
Golden dataset must contain at least 1,000 employee records
Payroll records with no HRIS match should stay below 75%
